steps.question: What is the shape of the moon according to the poem?

questionMeaning.hi: कविता के अनुसार चाँद का आकार कैसा है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kavita ke anusaar chaand ka aakaar kaisa hai?

options: round, like the face of the clock in the hall
steps.answer: round, like the face of the clock in the hall
steps.modelAnswer: According to the poem, the moon has a round face like the clock in the hall.

modelMeaning.hi: कविता के अनुसार चाँद का चेहरा हॉल की घड़ी की तरह गोल है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kavita ke anusaar chaand ka chehra hall ki ghadi ki tarah gol hai.

steps.question: Where do the birdies sleep?
options: in the forks of the trees
steps.answer: in the forks of the trees
steps.modelAnswer: The birdies sleep in the forks of the trees.

modelMeaning.hi: चिड़ियाँ पेड़ों की डालियों के बीच सोती हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Chidiyaan pedon ki daaliyon ke beech soti hain.

steps.question: What is the dog doing?
options: howling by the door of the house
steps.answer: howling by the door of the house
steps.modelAnswer: The dog is howling by the door of the house.

modelMeaning.hi: कुत्ता घर के दरवाज़े पर हुआँ-हुआँ कर रहा है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kutta ghar ke darwaaze par huaan-huaan kar raha hai.

steps.question: Where is the bat?
options: It lies in bed at noon and comes out at night.
in the forks of the trees
steps.answer: It lies in bed at noon and comes out at night.
steps.modelAnswer: The bat lies in bed at noon and loves to come out in the moonlight.

modelMeaning.hi: चमगादड़ दोपहर में बिस्तर पर पड़ा रहता है और चाँदनी में बाहर आना पसंद करता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Chamgaadad dopahar mein bistar par pada rehta hai aur chaandni mein baahar aana pasand karta hai.

steps.question: What do the flowers and children do till morning?

questionMeaning.hi: फूल और बच्चे सुबह तक क्या करते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Phool aur bachche subah tak kya karte hain?

options: They close their eyes and sleep.
steps.answer: They close their eyes and sleep.
steps.modelAnswer: The flowers and children close their eyes and sleep till the sun rises in the morning.

modelMeaning.hi: फूल और बच्चे सुबह सूरज निकलने तक आँखें बंद करके सोते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Phool aur bachche subah sooraj nikalne tak aankhein band karke sote hain.

steps.question: What do the things that belong to the day do when the moon is out?

questionMeaning.hi: दिन वाली चीज़ें चाँद निकलने पर क्या करती हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Din waali cheezein chaand nikalne par kya karti hain?

options: They cuddle to sleep to be out of her way.
steps.answer: They cuddle to sleep to be out of her way.
steps.modelAnswer: The things that belong to the day cuddle up and sleep to be out of the moon's way.

modelMeaning.hi: दिन वाली चीज़ें चाँद के रास्ते से हटने के लिए सिमटकर सो जाती हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Din waali cheezein chaand ke raaste se hatne ke liye simatkar so jaati hain.

text.en: (B) Fill in the right word from the poem.
